scope.title: Re-verify A6 long-running-persistence controlled pilot gate

decision.reason: A6 counters and the degrade_to_full_reverification response are present and pass, but the Active Pilot gate is not graduated: the current tree has no ResumeContractVerifier, no FingerprintLeaseCoordinator/lease-before-checkpoint proof, no requiresReverification production result, and no A6 pause/resume p99 test.

criterion1_volatileMislabel.threshold: volatileMislabelCount MUST remain 0; any non-zero -> critical violation

criterion3_p99.evidence: no A6 pause/resume performance test; tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts covers A5+A1+A3 only

criterion6_budgetAction.threshold: volatile mislabel OR fail rate >5% -> degrade_to_full_reverification

specDriftFixed.guard: tests/unit/a06-a6-gate-coverage.test.ts pins requiredTests, critical counter/action, and the missing verifier/lease/reverification boundary

rootEvidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/deprecation-counters.test.ts tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts tests/unit/file-fingerprint.test.ts tests/unit/runtime-resume-shadow.test.ts tests/unit/long-task-checkpoint-builder.test.ts tests/unit/long-task-control.test.ts tests/unit/a06-a6-gate-coverage.test.ts

residual.verifier: ResumeContractVerifier and requiresReverification are absent; no production rollback->reverification path can be claimed.
residual.lease: FingerprintLeaseCoordinator and lease-before-checkpoint ordering are absent; file fingerprint hashes alone do not prove Blocker 4.
residual.latency: No A6 10-cycle pause/resume p99 test; performance is NOT-MEASURED.
residual.pilotOnly: A6 remains a controlled pilot; no default-on/GA, no product lock change.
residual.scope: Deterministic unit/primitive evidence; no live provider/real-human.

independentVerification.detail: Counter and degradation-response criteria are mapped to current tests; missing verifier/lease/latency criteria are pinned as NO-GO/NOT-MEASURED. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.
